response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with strong full-stack, distributed-systems, and mentoring experience, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience (only a brief ~6-month stint at National Instruments plus a bachelor thesis project) and has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or production cloud architecture leadership experience. His background is heavily weighted toward TypeScript/Node.js/DLang web and GIS platforms rather than C++ infrastructure/compute systems.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and internal training
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and founder-level ownership of an open-source platform
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) versus the required 8 years
No clear experience leading or architecting large-scale cloud compute platforms
Career trajectory shows broad generalist full-stack/web focus rather than deep infrastructure/distributed-systems specialization

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform leadership experience
Strong mentoring and technical leadership soft skills
